verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an asynchronous Batch processing API for audio files (docs-2) and a documented operation to delete a job and its resources (docs-23), so transcription jobs exist as first-class resources. Nothing in the pack documents a status endpoint, the job state values, or a polling-until-done workflow, and no OpenAPI spec was found (probe-3). missing for 10: documented job-status endpoint, enumerated job states (e.g. running/done/rejected), polling or result-retrieval docs, hands-on corroboration.
